sections.title: A new little postposition
sections.content: ellen ("against") is a postposition, so like the ones you already know it follows its noun in its plain form: láz ellen ("against fever"), köhögés ellen ("against a cough"). At the pharmacy, Van valami X ellen? ("Is there something for X?") is the go-to way to ask for a remedy without needing the exact medicine's name.

items.english: Is there something for a fever?
I'd like something for a sore throat.

sections.content: valami ("something") plus ellen is worth learning as a fixed chunk — Van valami X ellen? works for almost any ailment you'll ever need to describe at a Hungarian gyógyszertár.
